Verifies when socket-layer network throttling applies, and when it stops.
A rejected command leaves the conditions unchanged:
Error: Socket-layer network throttling doesn't support throttling rules with a URL pattern yet.
fetch(): throttled
Detaching a session that set no conditions keeps them:
fetch(): throttled
Network.disable clears the conditions:
fetch(): not throttled
Detaching clears the conditions:
fetch(): throttled
fetch() after detaching: not throttled
Conditions without throttling don't throttle:
fetch(): throttled
fetch(): not throttled
The deprecated emulateNetworkConditions throttles too:
fetch(): throttled
fetch(): not throttled
